uncertain_terms.note: The source document is largely in English already (mixed Arabic headings and English body); the English source text is kept verbatim and only the Arabic parts were translated.
Header table reads 'القوة المحطة' / 'التقنية الإجراء' – garbled; rendered as 'Power Station' / 'Technical Procedure' by inference from the MPIS header pattern.
The specifications table row label 'يكتب' (literally 'writes') is unclear; rendered as 'Type' by inference. The 300-ton type value '26-I 20 I 22- Π C' is garbled and kept verbatim.
Source 'on an annually bases' kept verbatim; 'bases' is presumably a typo for 'basis'.
'المقاولين' rendered as 'contactors'; the source wording is literally 'contractors', which appears to be a mistranscription of the contactor term.
Source 'إجراء مراجعة ل محركات المؤيدين' is garbled; rendered as 'Overhaul the auxiliary motors' by inference ('المؤيدين' possibly a mistranscription of 'المساعدين').
'Switch off the AC current' appears twice in the source safety list; reproduced as-is.
'التعيين' in the footer rendered as 'Assignment'; the intended field label is unclear.
